page_title: NAP 2-1 PAR | Napoli v Parma 31/08/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+16' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.

90+16' Alex Meret pulls off a superb save! He leapt to block the shot Pontus Almqvist (Parma) fired on target after a rebound. His effort from inside the box flew straight towards the roof of the net, but was stopped by the goalkeeper.
90+13' Nice passing game by Napoli. They are increasing their possession with a series of long passes and waiting for the right moment to create an attacking opportunity.

90+6' 2 - 1 Goal! David Neres hands Frank Anguissa (Napoli) the simplest of tasks from close range after the cross evaded the keeper, and he makes no mistake with his header into the roof of the net. 2:1.
90+6' The ball is out of play. Napoli win a corner kick.
90+6' David Neres (Napoli) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. Napoli earn a corner.
90+4' Napoli can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
90+2' 1 - 1 Goal! Romelu Lukaku (Napoli) takes a short pass from Leonardo Spinazzola in his stride in the box, jinks inside his man and unleashes an unstoppable shot inside the right post. 1:1.
90+1' Referee Paride Tremolada reverses his original decision after the VAR review. There was no infringement and subsequently it’s not a penalty.
90' The fourth official shows 11 min. of added time.
90' Celebrations by Napoli are cut short as the referee signals that the penalty decision will be checked using the VAR. Hopefully it won’t take too long.
88' Enrico Del Prato (Parma) sees a yellow card. He should be more careful because one more challenge like that could result in a red card.

88' Referee Paride Tremolada sees the trip by Pontus Almqvist (Parma) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle. The referee makes a quick call and points to the penalty spot. Big scoring opportunity for Napoli.

87' A lofted pass evades the keeper and lands right on the head of Giovanni Simeone (Napoli) in the centre of the box, but his header sails narrowly wide of the right post when an empty net was beckoning.
85' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) strikes the ball harmlessly from a long-range free kick and it goes high over the bar. It's not easy to score from a distance like that.
82' The Napoli players are exchanging some short passes.
80' David Neres (Napoli) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Enrico Del Prato intercepts the ball.
78' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Giovanni Simeone (Napoli) is coming onto the pitch as Pasquale Mazzocchi cannot continue after picking up an injury.
75' Zion Suzuki (Parma) does not realise that he has already received a yellow card and is shocked when the referee shows him a second one!
75' Paride Tremolada has a clear sight and sees a foul from Zion Suzuki (Parma).
73' It is time for a substitution. Yordan Osorio (Parma) is on for Botond Balogh.
73' Fabio Pecchia has decided to substitute Valentin Mihaila and he is replaced by Gabriel Charpentier (Parma).
69' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Matteo Politano walks off the pitch to be replaced by David Neres (Napoli).

66' Alessandro Buongiorno (Napoli) wasted a golden opportunity after expertly receiving a cross from the free kick and shooting from close range. Unfortunately for him, his aim was off and he hit the crossbar!
63' The referee Paride Tremolada awards Zion Suzuki (Parma) a yellow card.
63' Romelu Lukaku (Napoli) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
62' It's time for a substitution. Romelu Lukaku (Napoli) comes on in place of Giacomo Raspadori.
61' Yellow card! It's like Valentin Mihaila (Parma) was asking for a caution with his behaviour. Paride Tremolada agrees and books him.

61' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) gets on the end of a defence splitting pass inside the box and immediately directs a low shot towards the middle of the goal, but the Zion Suzuki makes a great save.
60' A cross from a corner kick by Parma is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
59' Dennis Man (Parma) tries his luck from the edge of the box after a brilliant solo effort, but it is well blocked by the defender. Parma have been awarded a corner kick.
59' Referee Paride Tremolada has finally had enough of Antonio Conte and brandishes a yellow card at him!
58' The game is interrupted because of a yellow card that is shown to Stanislav Lobotka (Napoli).
57' Paride Tremolada blows his whistle after Stanislav Lobotka (Napoli) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.
57' Substitution. Mateusz Kowalski makes his way off the pitch and Pontus Almqvist (Parma) comes on as his replacement.
57' Fabio Pecchia has decided to make a change. Matteo Cancellieri (Parma) replaces Ange-Yoan Bonny.
56' What a big chance! Giacomo Raspadori (Napoli) picks up an inch-perfect pass inside the box and skies the ball well over the bar.

55' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) wastes an opportunity. He finds himself in acres of space and fires in a terrific shot from long range straight towards the right side of the target, but the goalkeeper makes a brilliant save and stops this one!

52' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) meets a pass on the edge of the penalty area and shoots towards the middle of the goal. He didn't put enough power into the effort, though, and Zion Suzuki pulls off an easy save.
50' Napoli failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
49' The ball is cleared after Matteo Politano (Napoli) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. Good work from Napoli as they win a corner.
49' Simon Sohm (Parma) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
48' Simon Sohm (Parma) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
46' Here is a change after the half-time break. Mathias Olivera is replaced by Leonardo Spinazzola (Napoli).
46' The second half has just started.
45+5' The match has reached half-time.
45+4' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
45+2' Parma work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.

45+1' Adrian Bernabe Garcia (Parma) hammers the ball towards goal from long-range, but one of the defenders reacts brilliantly to block the shot. The ball goes out of play. Parma are awarded a corner kick.
45' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
43' Frank Anguissa (Napoli) receives a yellow card from the referee, but it seems like a very harsh decision.
40' A neat pass is well received by Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli), who is lurking on the edge of the box and strikes the ball on goal. The goalkeeper makes a decent save to block his shot.
40' Napoli take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
39' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli).
38' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Parma.
36' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 6:7.
33' Matteo Politano (Napoli) makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box after picking up a pass, but produces a poor effort that sails high over the bar.
28' An accurate pass to the edge of the box is well taken by Adrian Bernabe Garcia (Parma), whose instinctive shot towards goal flashes inches wide of the right post.
24' Pasquale Mazzocchi (Napoli) is well placed to meet a cross and sends a difficult header towards the bottom right corner, but the goalkeeper reacts well to stop the effort.
19' 0 - 1 Goal! Ange-Yoan Bonny (Parma) runs up to the ball, stops and waits for Alex Meret to commit before slotting the penalty into the middle of the goal.
19' Ange-Yoan Bonny (Parma) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.

18' Alex Meret (Napoli) tackles a bit over-zealously and Paride Tremolada blows for a foul. PENALTY to Parma! Almost the entire opposition team is gathered around the referee and complaining. However, the decision has been made and it's final.
16' Mateusz Kowalski (Parma) latches on to a superb cross inside the box but only hits the crossbar with a fine header. What a chance!
13' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) takes the corner kick, but Zion Suzuki reads it well and stops the effort.
12' What a miss! Dennis Man (Parma) is left standing right in front of goal with only the keeper to beat after a clever pass, but he somehow contrives to toe poke the ball just past the right post.
11' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) sends in a poor cross from the corner and Zion Suzuki has no trouble gathering it.
11' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. Napoli get a corner.
8' A quickly taken corner by Napoli.
8' Substitution. Enrico Del Prato (Parma) replaces Emanuele Valeri.
7' Pasquale Mazzocchi (Napoli) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger. It will be a corner kick for Napoli.
6' The injury to Emanuele Valeri (Parma) looks like it might have ended his involvement in this match.
4' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) latches on to an accurate pass inside the box and immediately unleashes a shot towards goal, but it goes high over the crossbar.
2' Mateusz Kowalski (Parma) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Paride Tremolada blows his whistle for a foul. Napoli will take a free kick near the side line.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out at last! Napoli will take the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Paride Tremolada.
Show lineups You can have a look at the starting XIs of both teams in the details of this match.
